disclaimer: This prototype provides early-warning support and does not replace professional medical care.

alert_templates.Low risk: Continue monitoring and drink water regularly.
alert_templates.Moderate risk: Reduce exertion, rest periodically and move to a cooler area.
alert_templates.High risk: Stop strenuous activity, move to shade, drink water and notify a supervisor.
alert_templates.Very high risk: Stop activity and seek immediate assistance now.
